results.question: How many customers are there?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many orders are pending?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many products are in the catalog?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products FROM products AS p LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many orders were cancelled?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' LIMIT 1000

results.question: List all products in the Service category with their prices.
Which products cost more than 100 dollars?
How many customers are from Pakistan?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers AS c WHERE c.country = 'Pakistan' LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many Enterprise customers do we have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers AS c WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many orders came through the mobile app?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders AS o WHERE o.channel = 'Mobile app' LIMIT 1000

results.question: List the 5 most expensive products.
results.sql: SELECT name AS product, category, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC, name LIMIT 5

results.question: Which 3 countries have the most customers?
results.sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers AS c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY customers DESC, 1 LIMIT 3

results.question: How many customers are there in each country?
results.sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers AS c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many orders are there in each status?
results.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many orders came from each sales channel?
results.sql: SELECT o.channel, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders AS o GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many products are in each category?
results.sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS products FROM products AS p GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY products DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is the average product price in each category?
How many customers are in each segment?
results.sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers AS c GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is our total revenue?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' LIMIT 1000

results.question: Show revenue by customer country
results.sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: What was total revenue by month?
results.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000

results.question: Show the top 5 products by revenue
results.sql: SELECT p.name AS product, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: What is the revenue for each product category?
results.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is the revenue by sales channel?
results.sql: SELECT o.channel, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is the average order value of completed orders?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(o.total_amount) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_order_value FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' LIMIT 1000

results.question: Which country generated the most revenue?
results.sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC, 1 LIMIT 1

results.question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' LIMIT 1000

results.question: What was the total revenue in 2024?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many orders were placed in March 2025?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-03-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-04-01' LIMIT 1000

results.question: Compare total revenue in 2024 and 2025.
results.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY') AS year, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000

results.question: Which month in 2025 had the highest revenue?
results.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC, 1 LIMIT 1

results.question: How many customers signed up in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM customers AS c WHERE c.created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND c.created_at < '2026-01-01' LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many orders were placed on weekends?
How many orders were placed in each month of 2025?
results.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000

results.question: On average, how many days does it take to ship an order?
How many orders have no shipped date?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE shipped_date IS NULL LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many completed orders are missing a shipped date?
What percentage of all orders have a shipped date? Round to one decimal place.
List the orders placed on 31 December 2025 with the customer's name.
Which customers have placed more than 20 orders?
Who are the top 5 customers by total spend on completed orders?
results.sql: SELECT c.name AS customer, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS revenue FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.name LIMIT 5

results.question: How many orders has each Enterprise customer placed?
Which products have never been ordered?
results.sql: SELECT p.name AS product, p.category, p.unit_price FROM products AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_items AS oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.id) ORDER BY p.name LIMIT 1000

results.question: Which customers have never placed an order?
results.sql: SELECT c.name AS customer, c.country, c.segment, c.created_at FROM customers AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is the total quantity sold of each product in completed orders?
Which product category earns the most revenue from Enterprise customers?
What is the average order value for each customer segment, counting completed orders only?
results.sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(CAST(AVG(o.total_amount) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_order_value FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY average_order_value DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: Which customers from Canada placed an order in December 2025?
How many different customers placed at least one order in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers FROM orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is the revenue per country for orders placed through the website?
results.sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.channel = 'Website' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1000
